sam (PM): Quick heads-up — pushed a new compare-table iteration into the Figma link. Need quick feedback on: filter behaviour (multi-select vs chips), how performance badges map to metrics, and the version-pinning affordance. Can people skim? :eyes: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/model-catalog-compare

aj (Design): Skimmed — nice layout. A few things:
- Filters feel heavy when all collapsed. What if we convert 'Model type' into a single-select pill row and keep advanced filters in a drawer?
- Compare table: row density looks fine but the pin action feels ambiguous. Users expect pin on the row, not in header.

marie (Product): Agree re: pin. Current mock shows a header-level toggle that pins the whole comparison set. We need two distinct actions: 1) pin model VERSION to a workspace (persisted) and 2) pin a compare ROW (temporary snapshot). Try different icons or a contextual menu.

thomas (Eng): For badges we need precise thresholds so backend tagging can be consistent. Proposed rules:
```
badges:
  green: p99 < 50ms
  amber: p99 >= 50ms and p99 < 150ms
  red: p99 >= 150ms
```
Also: prefer numeric tooltips on hover (p50, p95, p99) instead of just color names.

aj (Design): Love the tooltip idea. UX nit: badges are tiny and low-contrast on the light theme. We should increase min color contrast and add an icon + text for screen readers. Maybe show "⚡ 45ms p99" on hover for compact mode.

aria (A11y): Echo contrast callout. Two accessibility items:
1) Badges must meet 4.5:1 contrast against the container or have a clear non-color indicator.
2) Keyboard focus order for the compare rows + pin action: when you expand a row details panel, focus should go to the close button inside the panel. Right now tab order jumps.

luis (Research): On metric naming — 'latency' in the table is ambiguous. We should standardize label to 'p99 latency (ms)' and in the column header allow an inline legend that links to a definition doc. Also suggest adding a small sparkline to show stability across recent runs; impacts pin decision.

sam (PM): Great — can we converge on:
- Pin affordances: row-pin (temporary snapshot) vs version-pin (persistent) with clear iconography + confirm toast.
- Badges: use thomas thresholds, aj to propose color palette w/ contrast, aria to sign off on A11y checks.
- Filters: move advanced filters to drawer, keep top-level pills for common dims.
Action items: @aj to post updated mocks by EOD Wed; @thomas to wire badge thresholds in the metrics backend by Friday; @aria to test keyboard nav after mocks.

aj (Design): I'll update mocks. Quick question: for multi-select filters, do we allow AND or OR by default? My instinct: OR for model-tags, AND for performance buckets. Thoughts?

marie (Product): Default OR for tags (users expect inclusive lists). For performance buckets, AND makes sense only if we expose range combos — could be confusing. Keep single-select for performance buckets initially.

thomas (Eng): Implementation note: OR semantics are cheaper (set union) but if we need complex boolean combos we'll need a query layer change. Prefer to start simple.
